name: Limit Journal Entry 3
definition: Journal entries track changes to the utilisation of the limit. Entries exist for all activity impacting the limit.

JournalDate.name: Journal Date
JournalDate.definition: Date and time for which the limit journal entry applies.

CreditDebitIndicator.name: Credit Debit Indicator
CreditDebitIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the entry is a credit or a debit entry.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Amount of money of individual entry impacting the limit.

MarketInfrastructureTransactionIdentific.name: Market Infrastructure Transaction Identification
MarketInfrastructureTransactionIdentific.definition: Identification of a transaction assigned by a market infrastructure other than a central securities depository, for example, Target2-Securities.

TransactionIdentification.name: Transaction Identification
TransactionIdentification.definition: Unique reference as assigned by the account owner institution to unambiguously identify the entry.

AccountServicerReference.name: Account Servicer Reference
AccountServicerReference.definition: Unique reference as assigned by the account servicing institution to unambiguously identify the entry.

ProcessorTransactionIdentification.name: Processor Transaction Identification
ProcessorTransactionIdentification.definition: Identification of the transaction assigned by the processor.
